scripts.build: pnpm --dir apps/assistant-web build && pnpm --dir apps/admin-web build
scripts.clean:next-types: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); for (const path of ['apps/assistant-web/.next/dev', 'apps/admin-web/.next/dev']) fs.rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm clean:next-types && pnpm --dir apps/assistant-web typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/admin-web typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/widget-loader typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/browser-extension typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm test:python && pnpm test:vitest && pnpm test:playwright
